principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority

roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

module_map.binding: Exact approved per-role module map; all entry fields have source types. MODULE_KEY is the lexicographically first complete canonical key in that independently approved map. frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private endpoint-subject/retained nontransferable-use context from A3; HOST-held expected public endpoint manifest is a separate readonly value, never an Ed25519 POSTMASTER message key.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority
All accepted effective-ACL entries and conditions, not assumed installed PostgreSQL grants

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

graph_fixture_objects.bindings: Object/schema/function/default-ACL IDs are typed symbolic natural-key references, with owner, ACL, body/config/effect manifest and source version independently bound. No object is created or installed.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

baseline_constraints: expected and candidate identity tuples are initially equal field-by-field; every digest references its full canonical tuple rather than replacing proof with a file hash
candidate actual emitter identity/enrollment/credential/purpose and kernel birth anchor bind the actual source ABI sender; POSTMASTER type201 is emitted by CENSUS_OBSERVER
current ledger high-water=G; current registry enrollment revision is independently witnessed; retired-generation set contains G_SOURCE and excludes G
current subject enrollment is ENROLLED and operational phase ACTIVE for ordinary current-generation cases; new-qualification/UNKNOWN variants explicitly override only their named state components
Reader source context is its own bound session/process and fixed operation; S03 uses its independent authenticated LOGIN bridge and is not substituted for S01
all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority
All accepted effective-ACL entries and conditions, not assumed installed PostgreSQL grants

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

graph_fixture_objects.type: complete rows of exact relevant CATALOG schema
graph_fixture_objects.bindings: Object/schema/function/default-ACL IDs are typed symbolic natural-key references, with owner, ACL, body/config/effect manifest and source version independently bound. No object is created or installed.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

baseline_constraints: expected and candidate identity tuples are initially equal field-by-field; every digest references its full canonical tuple rather than replacing proof with a file hash
candidate actual emitter identity/enrollment/credential/purpose and kernel birth anchor bind the actual source ABI sender; POSTMASTER type201 is emitted by CENSUS_OBSERVER
current ledger high-water=G; current registry enrollment revision is independently witnessed; retired-generation set contains G_SOURCE and excludes G
current subject enrollment is ENROLLED and operational phase ACTIVE for ordinary current-generation cases; new-qualification/UNKNOWN variants explicitly override only their named state components
Reader source context is its own bound session/process and fixed operation; S03 uses its independent authenticated LOGIN bridge and is not substituted for S01
all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects
R has no ownership, memberships, superuser, CREATEROLE or BYPASSRLS. Invocation is fixed-source INVOKER-only, no caller-provided identifiers, callback, generic SQL or raw descriptor export
M/A are typed test-model catalog principals, not created roles; candidate membership/ACL/call effects have complete source fields and explicit edge kinds, never merged authority booleans

frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority

candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

module_map.binding: Exact approved per-role module map; all entry fields have source types. MODULE_KEY is the lexicographically first complete canonical key in that independently approved map. Candidate map has the same keys before mutation. Module map is a declared design projection, not an invented native frame field.

frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority
All accepted effective-ACL entries and conditions, not assumed installed PostgreSQL grants

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. Before kind=FIXED_PROJECTION and projected_field_schema_ref=CATALOG/pg_catalog.pg_roles. Candidate body/effect digest is separate from unchanged independently expected manifest.

candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). Candidate namespace N_ATTACK and its relation T_ATTACK are complete source-typed pg_namespace/pg_class rows; N_ATTACK!=pg_catalog, T_ATTACK.relname=pg_roles,T_ATTACK.relnamespace=N_ATTACK and T_ATTACK.oid!=OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles). No actual namespace/object is created.

roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

graph_fixture_objects.type: complete rows of exact relevant CATALOG schema
graph_fixture_objects.bindings: Object/schema/function/default-ACL IDs are typed symbolic natural-key references, with owner, ACL, body/config/effect manifest and source version independently bound. No object is created or installed.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

baseline_constraints: expected and candidate identity tuples are initially equal field-by-field; every digest references its full canonical tuple rather than replacing proof with a file hash
candidate actual emitter identity/enrollment/credential/purpose and kernel birth anchor bind the actual source ABI sender; POSTMASTER type201 is emitted by CENSUS_OBSERVER
current ledger high-water=G; current registry enrollment revision is independently witnessed; retired-generation set contains G_SOURCE and excludes G
current subject enrollment is ENROLLED and operational phase ACTIVE for ordinary current-generation cases; new-qualification/UNKNOWN variants explicitly override only their named state components
Reader source context is its own bound session/process and fixed operation; S03 uses its independent authenticated LOGIN bridge and is not substituted for S01
all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects
R has no ownership, memberships, superuser, CREATEROLE or BYPASSRLS. Invocation is fixed-source INVOKER-only, no caller-provided identifiers, callback, generic SQL or raw descriptor export

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

module_map.binding: Exact approved per-role module map; all entry fields have source types. MODULE_KEY is the lexicographically first complete canonical key in that independently approved map. frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority
All accepted effective-ACL entries and conditions, not assumed installed PostgreSQL grants

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

graph_fixture_objects.bindings: Object/schema/function/default-ACL IDs are typed symbolic natural-key references, with owner, ACL, body/config/effect manifest and source version independently bound. No object is created or installed.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation

all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects

parameter_model.subject: ENFORCEMENT_WORKER

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

module_map.binding: Exact approved per-role module map; all entry fields have source types. MODULE_KEY is the lexicographically first complete canonical key in that independently approved map. Candidate map has the same keys before mutation. Module map is a declared design projection, not an invented native frame field.

frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority
All accepted effective-ACL entries and conditions, not assumed installed PostgreSQL grants

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. Before kind=FIXED_PROJECTION and projected_field_schema_ref=CATALOG/pg_catalog.pg_roles. Candidate body/effect digest is separate from unchanged independently expected manifest.

candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). Candidate namespace N_ATTACK and its relation T_ATTACK are complete source-typed pg_namespace/pg_class rows; N_ATTACK!=pg_catalog, T_ATTACK.relname=pg_roles,T_ATTACK.relnamespace=N_ATTACK and T_ATTACK.oid!=OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles). No actual namespace/object is created.

roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

graph_fixture_objects.type: complete rows of exact relevant CATALOG schema
graph_fixture_objects.bindings: Object/schema/function/default-ACL IDs are typed symbolic natural-key references, with owner, ACL, body/config/effect manifest and source version independently bound. No object is created or installed.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

baseline_constraints: expected and candidate identity tuples are initially equal field-by-field; every digest references its full canonical tuple rather than replacing proof with a file hash
candidate actual emitter identity/enrollment/credential/purpose and kernel birth anchor bind the actual source ABI sender; POSTMASTER type201 is emitted by CENSUS_OBSERVER
current ledger high-water=G; current registry enrollment revision is independently witnessed; retired-generation set contains G_SOURCE and excludes G
current subject enrollment is ENROLLED and operational phase ACTIVE for ordinary current-generation cases; new-qualification/UNKNOWN variants explicitly override only their named state components
Reader source context is its own bound session/process and fixed operation; S03 uses its independent authenticated LOGIN bridge and is not substituted for S01
all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects
R has no ownership, memberships, superuser, CREATEROLE or BYPASSRLS. Invocation is fixed-source INVOKER-only, no caller-provided identifiers, callback, generic SQL or raw descriptor export
M/A are typed test-model catalog principals, not created roles; candidate membership/ACL/call effects have complete source fields and explicit edge kinds, never merged authority booleans

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private endpoint-subject/retained nontransferable-use context from A3; HOST-held expected public endpoint manifest is a separate readonly value, never an Ed25519 POSTMASTER message key.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority

roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

graph_fixture_objects.bindings: Object/schema/function/default-ACL IDs are typed symbolic natural-key references, with owner, ACL, body/config/effect manifest and source version independently bound. No object is created or installed.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

baseline_constraints: expected and candidate identity tuples are initially equal field-by-field; every digest references its full canonical tuple rather than replacing proof with a file hash
candidate actual emitter identity/enrollment/credential/purpose and kernel birth anchor bind the actual source ABI sender; POSTMASTER type201 is emitted by CENSUS_OBSERVER
current ledger high-water=G; current registry enrollment revision is independently witnessed; retired-generation set contains G_SOURCE and excludes G
current subject enrollment is ENROLLED and operational phase ACTIVE for ordinary current-generation cases; new-qualification/UNKNOWN variants explicitly override only their named state components
Reader source context is its own bound session/process and fixed operation; S03 uses its independent authenticated LOGIN bridge and is not substituted for S01
all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects
R has no ownership, memberships, superuser, CREATEROLE or BYPASSRLS. Invocation is fixed-source INVOKER-only, no caller-provided identifiers, callback, generic SQL or raw descriptor export
M/A are typed test-model catalog principals, not created roles; candidate membership/ACL/call effects have complete source fields and explicit edge kinds, never merged authority booleans

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

module_map.binding: Exact approved per-role module map; all entry fields have source types. MODULE_KEY is the lexicographically first complete canonical key in that independently approved map. Candidate map has the same keys before mutation. Module map is a declared design projection, not an invented native frame field.

frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private endpoint-subject/retained nontransferable-use context from A3; HOST-held expected public endpoint manifest is a separate readonly value, never an Ed25519 POSTMASTER message key.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority
All accepted effective-ACL entries and conditions, not assumed installed PostgreSQL grants

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. Before kind=FIXED_PROJECTION and projected_field_schema_ref=CATALOG/pg_catalog.pg_roles. Candidate body/effect digest is separate from unchanged independently expected manifest.

candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). Candidate namespace N_ATTACK and its relation T_ATTACK are complete source-typed pg_namespace/pg_class rows; N_ATTACK!=pg_catalog, T_ATTACK.relname=pg_roles,T_ATTACK.relnamespace=N_ATTACK and T_ATTACK.oid!=OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles). No actual namespace/object is created.

roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

graph_fixture_objects.type: complete rows of exact relevant CATALOG schema
graph_fixture_objects.bindings: Object/schema/function/default-ACL IDs are typed symbolic natural-key references, with owner, ACL, body/config/effect manifest and source version independently bound. No object is created or installed.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

baseline_constraints: expected and candidate identity tuples are initially equal field-by-field; every digest references its full canonical tuple rather than replacing proof with a file hash
candidate actual emitter identity/enrollment/credential/purpose and kernel birth anchor bind the actual source ABI sender; POSTMASTER type201 is emitted by CENSUS_OBSERVER
current ledger high-water=G; current registry enrollment revision is independently witnessed; retired-generation set contains G_SOURCE and excludes G
current subject enrollment is ENROLLED and operational phase ACTIVE for ordinary current-generation cases; new-qualification/UNKNOWN variants explicitly override only their named state components
Reader source context is its own bound session/process and fixed operation; S03 uses its independent authenticated LOGIN bridge and is not substituted for S01
all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects
R has no ownership, memberships, superuser, CREATEROLE or BYPASSRLS. Invocation is fixed-source INVOKER-only, no caller-provided identifiers, callback, generic SQL or raw descriptor export
M/A are typed test-model catalog principals, not created roles; candidate membership/ACL/call effects have complete source fields and explicit edge kinds, never merged authority booleans

parameter_model.future_binding_rule: A future static fixture instantiation must supply EVERY typed parameter and verify all source equalities/constraints. Missing/inconsistent parameters => NOT_EVALUABLE, never assumed true. No such binding is instantiated in C5D.
parameter_model.constraint_application: This is a reusable declaration library. Only the case-selected views and explicit variant state below apply; a T8 or pending-qualification case does not also require the ordinary ACTIVE/ENROLLED target-state assumption.
parameter_model.information_flow: Raw source config/body values, internal source descriptor and source snapshot rows belong only to the trusted membrane model. Reader receives only approved sanitized projections/digests. No model signature, body hash or public endpoint manifest grants source authority.

DECISION_PREDICATE.PASS: Only after future evaluation: all typed fixture parameters and source constraints are bound; exact intended violation is demonstrated; calculated native authority decision satisfies the source-specific required outcome and no new authority/work/publication is granted.
DECISION_PREDICATE.FAIL: Only after future evaluation with complete inputs: the witness proposition is false or new unauthorized authority/work/publication is granted, or the calculated decision disagrees with the exact resolved canonical expected decision.
DECISION_PREDICATE.UNKNOWN_NOT_EVALUABLE: Any missing/unbound required parameter, invalid source/binding, unresolved canonical outcome mapping or incomplete specification => NOT_EVALUABLE. Never infer PASS from a known expected string.

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

module_map.binding: Exact approved per-role module map; all entry fields have source types. MODULE_KEY is the lexicographically first complete canonical key in that independently approved map. frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority
All accepted effective-ACL entries and conditions, not assumed installed PostgreSQL grants

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. Before kind=FIXED_PROJECTION and projected_field_schema_ref=CATALOG/pg_catalog.pg_roles. Candidate body/effect digest is separate from unchanged independently expected manifest.

candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). Candidate namespace N_ATTACK and its relation T_ATTACK are complete source-typed pg_namespace/pg_class rows; N_ATTACK!=pg_catalog, T_ATTACK.relname=pg_roles,T_ATTACK.relnamespace=N_ATTACK and T_ATTACK.oid!=OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles). No actual namespace/object is created.

roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

graph_fixture_objects.type: complete rows of exact relevant CATALOG schema
graph_fixture_objects.bindings: Object/schema/function/default-ACL IDs are typed symbolic natural-key references, with owner, ACL, body/config/effect manifest and source version independently bound. No object is created or installed.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

baseline_constraints: expected and candidate identity tuples are initially equal field-by-field; every digest references its full canonical tuple rather than replacing proof with a file hash
candidate actual emitter identity/enrollment/credential/purpose and kernel birth anchor bind the actual source ABI sender; POSTMASTER type201 is emitted by CENSUS_OBSERVER
current ledger high-water=G; current registry enrollment revision is independently witnessed; retired-generation set contains G_SOURCE and excludes G
current subject enrollment is ENROLLED and operational phase ACTIVE for ordinary current-generation cases; new-qualification/UNKNOWN variants explicitly override only their named state components
Reader source context is its own bound session/process and fixed operation; S03 uses its independent authenticated LOGIN bridge and is not substituted for S01
all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects
R has no ownership, memberships, superuser, CREATEROLE or BYPASSRLS. Invocation is fixed-source INVOKER-only, no caller-provided identifiers, callback, generic SQL or raw descriptor export
M/A are typed test-model catalog principals, not created roles; candidate membership/ACL/call effects have complete source fields and explicit edge kinds, never merged authority booleans

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

module_map.binding: Exact approved per-role module map; all entry fields have source types. MODULE_KEY is the lexicographically first complete canonical key in that independently approved map. Candidate map has the same keys before mutation. Module map is a declared design projection, not an invented native frame field.

frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority
All accepted effective-ACL entries and conditions, not assumed installed PostgreSQL grants

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. Before kind=FIXED_PROJECTION and projected_field_schema_ref=CATALOG/pg_catalog.pg_roles. Candidate body/effect digest is separate from unchanged independently expected manifest.

candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). Candidate namespace N_ATTACK and its relation T_ATTACK are complete source-typed pg_namespace/pg_class rows; N_ATTACK!=pg_catalog, T_ATTACK.relname=pg_roles,T_ATTACK.relnamespace=N_ATTACK and T_ATTACK.oid!=OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles). No actual namespace/object is created.

roles_for_graph_fixture.bindings: R=the source-authenticated Reader SQL role; A=existing deployment/owner SQL role; M=a distinct non-native symbolic intermediate catalog role. All fields are declared source types. R is not any native participant OS identity.

graph_fixture_objects.type: complete rows of exact relevant CATALOG schema
graph_fixture_objects.bindings: Object/schema/function/default-ACL IDs are typed symbolic natural-key references, with owner, ACL, body/config/effect manifest and source version independently bound. No object is created or installed.

policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

baseline_constraints: expected and candidate identity tuples are initially equal field-by-field; every digest references its full canonical tuple rather than replacing proof with a file hash
candidate actual emitter identity/enrollment/credential/purpose and kernel birth anchor bind the actual source ABI sender; POSTMASTER type201 is emitted by CENSUS_OBSERVER
current ledger high-water=G; current registry enrollment revision is independently witnessed; retired-generation set contains G_SOURCE and excludes G
current subject enrollment is ENROLLED and operational phase ACTIVE for ordinary current-generation cases; new-qualification/UNKNOWN variants explicitly override only their named state components
Reader source context is its own bound session/process and fixed operation; S03 uses its independent authenticated LOGIN bridge and is not substituted for S01
all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects
R has no ownership, memberships, superuser, CREATEROLE or BYPASSRLS. Invocation is fixed-source INVOKER-only, no caller-provided identifiers, callback, generic SQL or raw descriptor export
M/A are typed test-model catalog principals, not created roles; candidate membership/ACL/call effects have complete source fields and explicit edge kinds, never merged authority booleans

source_basis.proposition: Actual emitter and subject are independent

parameter_model.future_binding_rule: A future static fixture instantiation must supply EVERY typed parameter and verify all source equalities/constraints. Missing/inconsistent parameters => NOT_EVALUABLE, never assumed true. No such binding is instantiated in C5D.
parameter_model.constraint_application: This is a reusable declaration library. Only the case-selected views and explicit variant state below apply; a T8 or pending-qualification case does not also require the ordinary ACTIVE/ENROLLED target-state assumption.
parameter_model.information_flow: Raw source config/body values, internal source descriptor and source snapshot rows belong only to the trusted membrane model. Reader receives only approved sanitized projections/digests. No model signature, body hash or public endpoint manifest grants source authority.

frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

baseline_constraints: expected and candidate identity tuples are initially equal field-by-field; every digest references its full canonical tuple rather than replacing proof with a file hash

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

exact_variant_state.object_constructor: Exact source pg_class/pg_namespace/pg_proc/default_acl and exploded ACL field schemas bind full object identity, owner, schema usage, grants and verified body/effect inputs wherever the selected predicate requires them.
exact_variant_state.default_constructor: One exact SCHEMA_DEFAULT model: global (creator O,namespace0,kind FUNCTION) explicit empty ACL, owner implicit rights retained; schema (O,N!=0,FUNCTION) ABSENT before and full grant row after. No current-object ACL changes and no existing grant inferred from a future default.
exact_variant_state.source_effects: Closed A4.2 source capability/ACL model only; observed source/ACL data cannot mint active Reader authority. Negative paths are authority-claim attempts, not grants or successful SQL executions.

state.tuple_binding_rule: For each selected view, every relevant source-schema field has a typed named symbol and every referenced hash equals its complete tuple canonical hash. Nonselected declarations are not secretly assumed TRUE.
family_variant_constraints: Changing an ignored ambient search_path is not the mutation. One exact namespace/name resolution substitution is described; no callback choice or invalid native TLV is introduced

parameter_model.subject: RECEIVER

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

module_map.binding: Exact approved per-role module map; all entry fields have source types. MODULE_KEY is the lexicographically first complete canonical key in that independently approved map. Candidate map has the same keys before mutation. Module map is a declared design projection, not an invented native frame field.

frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

context.field_binding: Each declared field is a separately typed immutable parameter; exact shared-field equalities follow the source construction order, not a boolean valid-context flag.

identity_tuples.field_binding: For each subject/emitter and each declared field: symbol (model_id,actor,schema_id,field_name) with that exact source type; digest references equal the canonical hash of the complete bound tuple.

module_map.binding: Exact approved per-role module map; all entry fields have source types. MODULE_KEY is the lexicographically first complete canonical key in that independently approved map. Candidate map has the same keys before mutation. Module map is a declared design projection, not an invented native frame field.

frames.field_binding: Every exact field_order entry has a typed symbol. Subject fields bind the participant; sender_* fields bind actual sender, never subject-by-default. input_record/result_record use exact source nested schemas.

registry.field_binding: Every declared canonical field has a typed symbol; entity keys, predecessor digests and independent observed journal tip must match their referenced complete tuples.

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

private_resource.POSTMASTER_form: Private non-exportable slot/purpose/generation credential reference, never actual secret bytes.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.

snapshot.sources: ALL CATALOG/* complete row collections with exact projected columns and natural keys; typed OIDs are injectively bound to natural-key identities, never native OS enums.

binding.proposition: Closed source membrane, not raw SQL/table authority
All accepted effective-ACL entries and conditions, not assumed installed PostgreSQL grants

candidate_source_effect_leaf.binding: Leaf keyed exactly by callable_id=DESIGN/SOURCE_FIXED_PROJECT, operation_id=S01 and resource_relation=pg_catalog.pg_roles. candidate_resolution.binding: Before EXACT_FROZEN_IDENTITY(OID(pg_catalog.pg_roles),OID(pg_catalog),pg_roles). policy.constraint: Version-bound positive finite max age/deadline/lease, declared count/byte limits, no numeric production TTL invented; captured time and arithmetic constrained to source integer ranges.

all exact source collections share one snapshot/backend/barrier identity before mutation; complete typed row multisets preserve duplicates for validation
all7 concurrent subject principals and the required auxiliary custodians remain independently distinct; no equality of SQL roles and OS subjects

principals.constraint: All frozen concurrent MUST_BE_DISTINCT pairs have unequal OS subject/birth references; auxiliary writer/observer/source identities remain separately constrained.

work.binding: Challenge/work/input/result identities bind their exact canonical publication tuple; fresh and terminal history rows are separate typed values.
